info.title: Animica JSON-RPC
info.description:
Minimal JSON-RPC surface for Animica nodes: chain params & head, tx submit/query, built-in miner getwork/submit, and Data Availability (DA) post/get/proof.
Binary payloads are CBOR encoded and transported as 0x-prefixed hex unless otherwise stated.

methods.name: chain_getParams
methods.summary: Return canonical chain parameters.

methods.name: chain_getChainId
methods.summary: Return numeric chain id.

methods.name: chain_getChainIdentity
methods.summary: Return chain identity (chainId + genesis/fork/consensus/protocol).

methods.name: chain_getHead
methods.summary: Return current canonical head (header + number).

methods.name: block_getBlockByNumber
methods.summary: Return a block by height.

methods.name: block_getBlockByHash
methods.summary: Return a block by hash.

methods.name: tx_sendRawTransaction
methods.summary: Submit a signed CBOR transaction (hex).

methods.name: tx_getTransactionByHash
methods.summary: Lookup a transaction by hash.

methods.name: tx_getTransactionReceipt
methods.summary: Lookup a receipt by tx hash.

methods.name: miner.getWork
methods.summary: Return a work template for PoIES HashShare mining.

methods.name: miner_submitShare
methods.summary: Submit a share or full block candidate.

methods.name: da_putBlob
methods.summary: Post a blob into DA; returns commitment and receipt.

schema.description: Blob bytes (hex). Large uploads SHOULD use chunked REST in /da; this RPC is for small dev/test.

methods.name: da_getBlob
methods.summary: Fetch a blob by commitment.

methods.name: da_getProof
methods.summary: Get an availability/inclusion proof for a blob (or range).

schema.description: Optional share indices to prove; omitted ⇒ namespace range proof.

methods.name: miner.submitWork
methods.summary: Validate and accept a mined solution

methods.name: chain.getChainId
methods.summary: Return numeric chain id (dot-notation alias for chain_getChainId).

methods.name: chain.getHead
methods.summary: Return current canonical head (dot-notation alias for chain_getHead).

methods.name: tx.getTransactionByHash
methods.summary: Return a transaction by its hash. Accepts object or positional params.

methods.name: tx.getTransactionReceipt
methods.summary: Return the transaction receipt for a confirmed tx. Returns null for pending/unknown.

methods.name: tx.getStatus
methods.summary: Return the status of a transaction (pending/confirmed/failed/dropped/unknown).

methods.name: da.configure
methods.summary: Configure or reconfigure the node-side DA store.

methods.name: da.status
methods.summary: Get node-side DA layer status. Returns structured diagnostics including policy info.

methods.name: da.putBlob
methods.summary: Upload a blob to the node DA store. Requires allow_remote_put=true.

errors.message: DA remote blob upload is blocked by policy (allow_remote_put=false)

methods.name: aicf.creditsByAddress
methods.summary: Get AICF credits for an address. Accepts object or positional params.

methods.name: aicf.getClaimable
methods.summary: Get claimable AICF credits for an address.

methods.name: aicf.claim
methods.summary: Claim AICF credits for an address.

methods.name: aicf.status
methods.summary: Get AICF system status and availability.

methods.name: state.getBalance
methods.summary: Get confirmed balance for an address. Returns stable schema with unit info.

examples.name: get_balance_zero
examples.description: Zero balance (address exists but no funds)

methods.name: node.health
methods.summary: Lightweight health check suitable for polling. Returns quickly without expensive scans.

methods.name: node.capabilities
methods.summary: Return Studio-facing feature flags, DA policy, AICF availability, and readiness info.

theta.description: Acceptance threshold Θ for this block.

headerTemplate.description: CBOR header sans nonce; miner fills nonce & mixSeed domain.

attachedProofs.description: Optional useful-work proofs (AI/Quantum/Storage/VDF) as CBOR envelopes.
